name: Exterior Engineered Wood Siding Surface Preparation
intent: Low-pressure wash, scuff sand, moisture check (engineered wood-specific), caulk siding-to-trim joints, dust cleanup. No end-seal (construction task). No power washing.
doctrine: NC prep for engineered wood siding. Low-pressure wash ONLY (power washing prohibited — damages factory primer, forces water into OSB core). Scuff sand on factory-primed and ExpertFinish surfaces for adhesion. Moisture check is engineered wood-specific — must read < 15% MC before coating (more moisture-sensitive than fiber cement). Caulk siding-to-trim joints only — NOT field butt joints (moisture trap against OSB core). No end-seal (construction task). Profile and texture modifiers apply to scuff sand.
